text: Mason was attending a fair in Eastvale, California on July 8, 2022. He was playing beer pong when he was struck in the head by a large clown named Billy. Mason suffered a severe concussion and brain damage. His hospital expenses from the injury spanned several months and summed up to $3200. Mason was attending a fair in Stockton, California on July 8, 2022. He was playing cup pong when he was struck in the head by a large clown named Watson. Mason suffered a minor concussion. His hospital expenses from the injury spanned 2 months and summed up to $300
